title: Standard event (state report) v1
description: One session's state as reported to the daemon by an adapter, a script (`emit`), or HTTP POST /v1/events. Compatibility: fields are only ever added; consumers MUST ignore unknown fields; `schema_version` is bumped only for incompatible changes (see schemas/README.md).
$comment: additionalProperties is intentionally not set to false: unknown fields are ignored, not rejected.

agent.description: Agent kind = character species (e.g. claude-code, codex, cron-script).

session.description: Session id = one character. Child sessions use '<parent>/<child id>' when the agent has no id of its own.

child_type.description: For a subagent: its kind as its agent names it (Claude Code's agent_type, a Codex thread's role), set by the daemon from the hooks; ignored on input.

cwd.description: Working directory (used for project and space rules; never displayed in screen-share mode).

delegations.description: Work the session handed to other sessions (a delegation tool, such as the Claude app's cloud session start), set by the daemon from the hooks; ignored on input. `open`: not yet back (where, who asked, since when); `returned`: results that came back as task notifications.

background.description: Daemon-set, informational: how much of the session's background work (commands, subagents, monitors it left running) still ran when its agent last said, as its hook counted it; absent when none. The session is not waiting for the owner: it rests while the work runs. Ignored on input.

launcher.description: Where the session runs (an app, an editor, a terminal), set by the daemon from the session's verified process; ignored on input.

title.description: The title the agent's own apps show for the session (Claude Code's session title, a Codex thread's name), read by the daemon; ignored on input.

space.description: Room id override; otherwise classified by rules.

summary.description: Short status text only; never conversation content.

detail.description: Current tool or waiting target. Control characters stripped by the sender; the daemon strips again.

scope.description: Whether the counts are a delta for this event or a running total (see docs/usage-and-cost.md dedupe rules).

ttl_s.description: For direct reports only: seconds after which the state is considered stale (→ unknown).
